info.name: AngeliteCare API
info.description: HAU Clinic — patient records, consultation queue and inventory. Run `npm run seed` first, then run folders top to bottom. Login saves the token automatically.

exec: { const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.token) pm.collectionVariables.set("token", j.token); }
{ const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.token) pm.collectionVariables.set("adminToken", j.token); }

{ const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.items.find(i => i.inStock && i.category === "medicine")._id) pm.collectionVariables.set("itemId", j.items.find(i => i.inStock && i.category === "medicine")._id); }
{ const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.ticket.id) pm.collectionVariables.set("ticketId", j.ticket.id); }
{ const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.data && j.data._id) pm.collectionVariables.set("visitId", j.data && j.data._id); }
{ const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.data._id) pm.collectionVariables.set("walkInId", j.data._id); }
{ const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.data._id) pm.collectionVariables.set("itemId", j.data._id); }
{ const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.data.batches[0]._id) pm.collectionVariables.set("batchId", j.data.batches[0]._id); }
{ const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.data._id) pm.collectionVariables.set("userId", j.data._id); }
